verdict.rationale: Keycloak's Server Administration Guide documents built-in SCIM endpoints per realm for managing users and groups, including service-account setup for external IdPs to sync directory data, which aligns with the security-engineer story of directory-driven provisioning/deprovisioning. However, the evidence is first-party docs only, with no independent/hands-on validation of end-to-end deprovisioning propagation or real-world SCIM integration experiences. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of SCIM working in production, explicit documentation of deprovisioning-triggered access revocation semantics, and details on supported customer-directory SCIM clients.
